description: Named scripts that run in the terminal of the active space with 1 click, 1 key or a button in the bar: sync the repository, install plugins, start a server. Variables such as {repo} and {branch} get their values from the terminal.

settings.label: Shortcut
settings.hint: Opens the Quick Actions list. Saved in keys.json.

settings.label: Actions
settings.hint: Make, change and delete the actions in the list.

settings.label: Script folder
settings.hint: Write with an agent puts the new script files here. ~ is your home folder. Empty: the default folder.

settings.label: Background timeout
settings.hint: An action or an agent that runs in the background stops after this time. A background job cannot answer a question, so a job that waits for one stops here.
